title: Redesigning and Auditing Deep Research Writing for Faithful Reports
abstract: arXiv:2608.28643v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rubric-based evaluations of deep-research (DR) systems often obscure fine-grained factual failures in generated reports. We introduce CLAIMPROBE, a claim-level audit that decomposes DR reports into claims and measures hallucination, misattribution, citation hygiene, and necessary-fact recall against retrieved evidence. Using CLAIMPROBE, we find that strong DR pipelines can omit key evidence and misattribute claims even when their rubric scores remain stable. We then propose CLAIMWRITER, a hierarchical claim-based writer that extracts source facts, maps them to a query-derived outline, and drafts each section from a source-linked claim representation. Across three prior DR frameworks, replacing only the report writer with CLAIMWRITER reduces hallucination by 2.6 to 4.5 times and improves necessary-fact recall by 1.2 to 1.7 times, while largely preserving overall report quality. translated_title: 面向忠实报告的深度研究写作的重新设计与审计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.28643v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于评分标准（rubric）的深度研究（DR）系统评估常常掩盖生成报告中的细粒度事实性错误。我们提出了CLAIMPROBE，一种声明级别的审计方法，它将深度研究报告分解为声明，并对照检索到的证据来衡量幻觉、错误归因、引用规范以及必要事实的召回率。利用CLAIMPROBE，我们发现即使强大的深度研究流水线在评分标准得分保持稳定的情况下，仍然可能遗漏关键证据并对声明进行错误归因。随后，我们提出了CLAIMWRITER，一种层次化的基于声明的写作器，它提取源事实，将其映射到由查询导出的大纲中，并基于与来源关联的声明表示来起草每个章节。在三个现有的深度研究框架中，仅将报告写作器替换为CLAIMWRITER，就能将幻觉减少2.6至4.5倍，并将必要事实召回率提升1.2至1.7倍，同时在很大程度上保持了整体报告质量。CLAIMWRITER还支持局部修订：当来源……
tldr: 提出CLAIMPROBE声明级审计方法和CLAIMWRITER层次化声明写作器，将深度研究报告的幻觉减少2.6至4.5倍、必要事实召回率提升1.2至1.7倍，同时保持整体报告质量。
en_tdlr: We introduce CLAIMPROBE, a claim-level audit revealing fine-grained factual failures in deep-research reports, and CLAIMWRITER, a hierarchical claim-based writer that reduces hallucination by 2.6–4.5x and improves necessary-fact recall by 1.2–1.7x while preserving overall report quality.
